ai.headline: RAG vs Agentic Architecture: Decision Framework and Trade-offs
ai.body: RAG is appropriate when answers live in documents — single retrieval, single generation, cheap and debuggable. Agents are for tasks requiring action on external systems: they run a reasoning loop, select tools, execute, and iterate until the goal is met. The cost is more tokens and compounding error drift across steps.

ai.headline: Claude Code Context Management: 5-Layer Lazy Degradation Strategy
ai.body: Before every model call, Claude Code runs up to five context-management strategies in escalating order of disruption: budget reduction (cap tool outputs), snip (trim oldest history), microcompact (prune tool turns by ID to preserve prompt cache), context collapse (read-time projection), and auto-compact (full model-generated summary as last resort). The architecture is instructive for anyone building long-running agentic sessions — prioritise cache warmth and avoid full summarisation until necessary.

ai.headline: Claude Code Internal Request Pipeline Traced from Source
ai.body: A prompt flows through: interface (CLI/IDE/SDK) → agent loop → permission system → tool dispatch → execution environment (shell/cloud/sandbox) → result fed back to agent loop → state persistence → streamed output. The permission system sitting between planning and execution is the architecturally critical gate for agentic security — the hardest layer to get right when building similar systems.

fin.headline: Kevin Warsh Sworn in as Fed Chair; Rate Policy Shift Expected
fin.body: Warsh was sworn in at the White House on 2026-05-23, replacing a predecessor Trump repeatedly criticised for resisting rate cuts. Trump signalled desire for lower rates at the ceremony. Markets will watch whether Warsh accelerates cuts — relevant to fintech funding conditions and fixed-income positioning across the portfolio.

swe.headline: Forward Proxy vs Reverse Proxy vs API Gateway: Architectural Boundaries
swe.body: Forward proxy represents the client (outbound policy enforcement, IP masking); reverse proxy represents the server (TLS termination, load distribution, backend shielding); API gateway is a reverse proxy augmented with auth, rate limiting, versioning, and request shaping applied consistently across microservices. In production, all three layers typically coexist — relevant to IAM/zero-trust architectures where policy enforcement points must be clearly separated.

mkt.headline: S&P 500 Posts Eighth Consecutive Weekly Gain; Reddit Falls on Meta Forum Threat
mkt.body: The S&P 500 closed its longest weekly winning streak since 2023, aided by Iran peace deal optimism. Reddit dropped ~5.6% after Meta announced a competing online forum product — a direct threat to Reddit's ad-revenue and data-licensing model.
